prediction_misses.registered_mechanism: This is the epic's central hypothesis, argued on the denominator that matches the answer set. These 13 cells return 8-67 raw grep hits per true call site, so the baseline must open and classify each hit to separate real calls from same-name methods on other receivers, comments, and string literals (Close: 269 hits for 4 call sites; FetchAuthUser: 64 hits for 1). Precision collapses, or the arm exhausts its budget. The treatment's callers resolves by symbol identity, so collision noise cannot enter its answer set at all. Precision, not recall, is the discriminating metric: the true sets are small (fan_in 1-16) while the hit sets are large.

MATCHED CONTROL: identical task shape and identical prompt template to callers_call_site_high, run on the easy cell of the SAME axis (<= 2 grep hits per true call site, versus 8-67 there). One grep returns at most a couple of hits per call site, nearly all true. Holding task shape fixed and varying only call-site collision noise is what isolates the noise mechanism from a generic tool-affordance advantage.

The arms are disjoint: the treatment has NO Grep. Exhaustive byte-exact substring retrieval — including inside comments and string literals — is grep's native operation and is the LCI index's structural blind spot, since a symbol/semantic index does not enumerate arbitrary raw byte matches in non-code text. The treatment must approximate the task through mcp__lci__search, which is a semantic/symbol query rather than a substring enumerator, and should lose recall on occurrences that are not symbol references.

RECORDED AS DIRECTIONAL INTUITION ONLY — NOT A TESTABLE PREDICTION AT THIS N. The intuition is that implementation discovery requires type-relationship knowledge (which types satisfy the interface) that grep cannot compute, so the baseline must guess from method-name matches. No threshold is authored for it because this sample cannot falsify one.

Prior tiers' ONLY reproducible LCI win was completion rate (DNF 10.8% -> 6.5%, a 4.3pp gap) while accuracy sat at dead parity (0.96 vs 0.96). The mechanism: the baseline spends budget on grep output volume and the file reads needed to classify hits, whereas the treatment's answers arrive in fewer, denser calls. Under a constrained budget this pre-existing gap should widen, because the baseline's per-answer token cost scales with call-site collision noise while the treatment's does not.

ENUMERATION LOAD, a different mechanism from collision noise. Depth-2 closure over a fan_in 9-28 symbol requires one grep round per depth-1 caller — 9-28 sequential greps plus per-hit classification — so baseline cost compounds multiplicatively with fan-in and it truncates the frontier or exhausts its budget. The treatment issues one callers call per frontier node with no classification step. Recall is the discriminating metric: the predicted baseline failure is an incomplete frontier, not a polluted one.
